cards.gameplay_text:
If the player owns more than 1 Demolition Company, then the player must demolish as many constructed landmarks as they have Demolition Companies.

City Hall does not count as a "Constructed Landmark"<ref>https://boardgamegeek.com/thread/1421480/does-city-hall-count-constructed-landmark</ref> for purposes of this card, and thus cannot be destroyed.
cards.strategy_text:
Since demolishing a landmark only yields 8 coins, it is only profitable in the long-term to destroy either a Harbor (if playing with the Harbor Expansion) and/or a Train Station. Every other landmark will cost more coins to rebuild than the yield from demolishing it. Due to this, it would be unwise to have any more than 2 copies in the city.

Since the effect of the card demolishes landmarks (effectively reversing game progression), this card is only viable as a part of a game strategy early on.

cards.effect: At the end of each of your turns, you may place 1 coin on this card. The total placed here is your investment. When activated, get an amount equal to your investment from all player, on your turn only.
cards.gameplay_text:
When the card's activation number of 10 is rolled, the player may take as many coins as there are on the card from each player, on their turn only.

Initially there are no coins on the card. The coin must be placed after the build phase of the player's turn.

The coins placed on this card are no longer part of the player's coins so cannot be used to purchase establishments or pay off debts. They also cannot be removed from the card.

cards.strategy_text:
It is not advisable to purchase the Train Station early in the game. The Train Station does not generate any money by itself, and the four coins needed to purchase it could be used to buy other money-generating Establishments.

Since all players initially lack the ability to roll higher than a six, the player should focus on obtaining Establishments whose activation numbers are six or less.

The card yields no money if no Vineyards have been constructed.

The Renovation effect of this card means that the Winery only generates income at most once every two activations.

Note that any new Wineries built whilst the existing ones are closed for renovations are open and will generate income.
